newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers quoted up, enquiries healthy.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers quoted up, enquiries healthy.

text.p: Singapore bunker suppliers lifted their quotes higher on Wednesday amid Japan's upcoming golden week holidays and less competitive prices in South Korea, traders said.

Prices in South Korea, Singapore's main competitor, rose amid domestic maintenance turnarounds, with the 180-cst grade quoted at $109 per tonne. In Singapore, the 180-cst was quoted by majors at $106/$107, compared with $103/$106 on Tuesday.
"Enquiries are pretty healthy so far," said one trader. "The high prices in South Korea has helped sentiment further."
